Definition
[Difference quotient] 1. ch7:7.53\group ch07-sobolev-spaces Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0180 For the $i$th coordinate vector $e_i$ and $h\neq 0$, set \begin{equation} \tag {7.53} \Delta _i^h u(x)=\Delta ^h u(x) =\frac{u(x+he_i)-u(x)}h. \end{equation}
